page_title: ETI 3-1 AUX | St Etienne v Auxerre 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
90+2' Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) tackles a bit over-zealously and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) will replace Leo Petrot.
86' 3 - 1 Goal! Lucas Stassin gets to the ball, slips Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 3:1.
83' Substitution. Elisha Owusu is replaced by Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre).
83' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Lassine Sinayoko is replaced by Florian Aye (Auxerre).
81' The referee blows his whistle as Louis Mouton (St Etienne) was too aggressive in his challenge.
79' Mathieu Vernice shows a yellow card to Leo Petrot (St Etienne) for a tough tackle.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) replaces Ibrahim Sissoko.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) for Mathis Amougou.
78' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
78' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to substitute Aimen Moueffek and he is replaced by Louis Mouton (St Etienne).
76' The corner is swung in but Auxerre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' 2 - 1 What a brilliant finish! Theo Bair (Auxerre) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and fires the ball past the helpless goalkeeper.
74' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
72' 38:62 – the latest ball possession ratio.
70' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Benjamin Old as he is replaced by Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne).
69' The resulting set piece from Auxerre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' Auxerre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

68' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the top right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
67' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) sees a yellow card from Mathieu Vernice after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
63' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ki-Jana Hoever leaves the pitch and Theo Bair (Auxerre) comes on.
60' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Paul Joly (Auxerre) replacing Gabriel Osho.
60' Substitution. Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) on for Ado Onaiwu.
56' Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul after Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
54' 2 - 0 Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. Although the shot low to the middle of the goal isn't very precise, it ends up in the net.
52' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Auxerre players look gutted.
52' Attention! Referee Mathieu Vernice straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
51' A goal, which was scored by Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre), was disallowed due to offside.
50' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) is adjudged offside.
49' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 8:4.
47' A yellow card for a tackle by Mickael Nade (St Etienne). Mathieu Vernice doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.

41' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
41' A fine pass finds Benjamin Old (St Etienne) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Donovan Leon reacts superbly to deny him.
38' Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
35' Today's referee Mathieu Vernice rightly decides to book Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) for his harsh tackle.

34' Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Donovan Leon makes a comfortable save.
33' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
30' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
26' St Etienne have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
23' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mathieu Vernice saw the whole situation.
20' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
18' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

15' 1 - 0 Goal! Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Donovan Leon had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:0.
13' St Etienne take a short corner kick.
13' Benjamin Old (St Etienne) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' St Etienne can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St Etienne comes to nothing.
6' A lofted pass finds Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Auxerre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Auxerre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
1' The ball is cleared after Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
St Etienne will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Mathieu Vernice.
